verdict.rationale: Bruno CLI (bru) is documented to run collections/requests from the command line, generate JSON/JUnit/HTML reports, and integrate with CI/CD pipelines, with official Docker images to avoid host Node.js dependencies for CI use. JUnit reporting enables build-failure gating in most CI systems. Missing for 10: explicit documented exit-code/fail-on-regression behavior and independent hands-on CI examples confirming build failure on test regressions.
